info.title: Sahsah gameplay API
info.description: Gameplay v1 contract, 2026-11-06. API-Q1–Q19 accepted and implemented on feat/gameplay-api. Auth/login/payment/staff/history-browser APIs excluded. Production integration and deployment certification are separate release prerequisites.

Bearer.description: Existing verified account ID token, or room-limited g.<membershipUUID>.<secret>. This document defines no login/OTP API.

OperationId.name: Idempotency-Key
OperationId.description: Stable per-intent UUID saved before send. Matching retry recovers outcome; changed semantic payload conflicts.

ControlSecret.name: X-Control-Secret
ControlSecret.description: Current opaque room/controller base proof. Never log.

GuestProof.name: X-Guest-Proof
GuestProof.description: Original anonymous membership grant for binding; requires verified account Bearer too.

Revision.description: Canonical unsigned decimal, runtime <=9223372036854775807. Exact bigint transport.

Score.description: Exact nonnegative team total; manual input ceiling is separate from subsequent legal awards.

ManualTarget.description: Manual target 0..1000000. Later question awards may exceed this target-input ceiling.

Time.description: UTC RFC3339 instant ending in Z.

Secret.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of exactly 32 CSPRNG bytes. Client saves before sending; server stores domain-separated hash only.

Selections.description: Distinct position/category; repeat basis only for explicitly accepted actual pack/roster. Start requires exactly six.

TimerRunning.description: A persisted running deadline can already display zero; no per-second DB writes.

Category.description: publishedPackCount counts only playable packs: published, unarchived, with six current questions. coverUrl is public category artwork, never gameplay media.

progress.description: Requester current-question completion/exposure. Updated means historical completion exists but replacement identities are not currently completed; ordinary text edits preserve progress.

PackPage.description: Sorted by packNumber,id. Client default is first group-fresh item from freshOnly=true,limit=1. Empty filtered items require choose-another-category or explicit repeat consent in the actual room.

MemberPatch.description: At least one of displayName/teamNumber required; host team changes use setup.

Departure.description: Viewer empty body. Host expectedRoomVersion and current controller headers; same atomic closure transition.

InitialSelections.description: Provisional distinct category/pack choices. Repeat consent is confirmed later against the actual room roster.

x-design-notes: Idempotency-Key required for effectful calls; not for fresh read-only media URL issuance.
Existing protected HTTP responses use Cache-Control: private,no-store. Public catalog may cache60s; personalized responses must not.
Current controller headers protect host actions/audio; current auth headers excluded from canonical semantic digest.
Timers after reveal/resolution are forbidden. Ready uses own member revision+Ready epoch. Source create/join/start identities outlive bounded receipts.
No load/production-capacity result is claimed. See admission-control and acceptance-and-handoff documents.
